review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped the neighbouring Aschbacher1976Full directory for the repeated helpers. Two small patterns recur. The first is transporting orderOf z = 2 across a MulEquiv with orderOf_injective, at lines 26 and 47. The second is transporting centralizer cardinalities with card_centralizer_transport, at lines 29 and 59. The centralizer transport already has a shared lemma, card_centralizer_transport in LeafDihedralBasic. The order transport is a one-line use of Mathlib's orderOf_injective, and a wrapper around it would be a thin one. The other steps differ between psl2_conclusion_of_centralizer and false_of_alternatingSeven. One concludes with PSL2 modular arithmetic. The other conjugates to a7t and gets the contradiction 3 ∣ 2^n. No nontrivial reasoning is repeated, so no finding meets the rubric. I could not run Lean, so I did not test any alternative proofs.
